evidence: CDLC-8592 (in-flight reference epic) and CDLC-8999 (complete epic, digitization stage)
bottomsOut: Sub-task level. Jira cannot nest beneath hierarchyLevel -1, and both leaf stages were confirmed to have no children.

epic.name: CDLC Epic
epic.blurb: One Epic is one course. Everything needed to take that course from a business brief to a published product hangs beneath it.

courseTypeFork.why: One field on the Epic decides which work types are created beneath it, all the way down. It is the single biggest branch in the lifecycle.

branches.then: Final Slides → Graphics + PPT Generation → Base Articulate File
Research Note → Slide Chunks → Graphic Definitions → PPT Generation → Articulate Creation

stages.name: Epic Creation
stages.what: A new epic is created for a course in the pipeline. The Course Type chosen here determines every work type created beneath it.
stages.automation: Epic + Business Specs & Course Brief, or Epic + Template Generation for Certification courses.

stages.name: Topic Creation
stages.what: A Topic is the primary child item under an Epic. The Instructional Designer assigned to the course creates and names it.
stages.automation: Certification ⇒ Certification: Research Notes. Instructional/Informational/Practical ⇒ CDLC: Topic Final Slides.

stages.name: Final Slides / Research Note Creation
stages.owner: Instructional Designer, then QA Specialist and SME
stages.what: The assigned Instructional Designer develops the content against the approved Learning Objectives, using approved tools and saving to the designated shared location.
stages.automation: Final Slides → Done creates Topic Graphics, and Topic PPT Generation for Instructional/Practical. Research Notes → Done creates Certification: Slide Chunks.

stages.name: Base Articulate / Slide Chunks Creation
stages.what: A PPT is generated by the Instructional Designer and shared with the Digitization team to create the Base Articulate file — the template for the final Articulate Storyline file, including voiceover, captions and slide titles. For Certification courses the Instructional Designer works on Slide Chunks instead.
stages.automation: PPT Generation → Done creates Base Articulate File Creation. Slide Chunks → Done creates Certification: Graphic Definitions.

stages.name: Graphics / Graphic Definition Creation
stages.owner: Visual Designer, or Instructional Designer for Certification
stages.what: For Instructional/Informational/Practical the Graphic Definition is written by the Instructional Designer during the final stages, and the Visual Designer incorporates graphics into the Articulate Storyline file. For Certification the Instructional Designer prepares the Graphic Definition.
stages.automation: Topic Graphics created ⇒ parent Topic moves to Ready for Graphics. Topic Graphics → Done ⇒ creates Articulate Review and Topic Corrections, parent Topic moves to In Review and its Articulate Review Link is filled in. Certification Graphic Definition → Done ⇒ creates Topic PPT Generation.

stages.name: Articulate Review
stages.owner: Instructional Designer, QA Specialist, Internal and External SME
stages.what: The Instructional Designer and Visual Designer have finished the Articulate Storyline file and share it for review. Status moves In Progress → In Review, and the Assignee changes each time a concern is raised or resolved.
stages.automation: Articulate Review → Done creates Topic Translations, Topic Assessment, SME Review and External Review. Certification: Articulate Creation → Done creates Topic Assessment.

stages.name: Translation & Digitization
stages.owner: Digitization Resource, Digitization Team Manager, QA Specialist
stages.what: Translation renders the finished, reviewed Articulate Storyline file into Spanish. Digitization then takes the course from finished content to a live product.
stages.automation: Moving the Epic to Digitization creates the whole digitization set: Badge and Course Image, Upload to AWS + Planning, Review, Restore on SkillCat, Data Sheet, Course Metadata, Course Introduction. Review → Done creates Generate Performance Report, which on Done creates Restrict Course Folder. Restore on SkillCat → Done creates Update Course Catalog and Run Image Archiving; Run Image Archiving → Done creates Move Source Files.

roles.does: Drafts, edits and iterates content in line with the brief.
Creates visuals and graphics aligning with the Instructional Designer's brief.
Reviews content for accuracy, tone, grammar and brand alignment.
Creates translations and ensures the course, with all its assets, is uploaded correctly to the app.
Provides specialist input and validates factual accuracy. Can be internal or external.

stages.name: Business Specs & Outline
stages.blurb: Opens the course. Produces the Scope Doc and Research Doc that everything downstream is built against.
stages.note: Jira describes this type as “Use this to create: Scope Doc & Research Doc”. The type is Course: Specs — not the similarly-named CDLC: Course outline work type, which is not used here. It has no subtasks: the whole stage is one ticket.

stages.name: Course Brief
stages.blurb: The briefing between Instructional Designer and SME, with the Video Director and QA Specialist present.
stages.note: The newest stage in the lifecycle — all 66 of its tickets were created within the last year. Like Business Specs, it carries no subtasks.

stages.name: Topic 1 … N
stages.blurb: The body of the course. One Topic per teaching unit, each carrying the same four production subtasks. The number of topics varies by course — the reference epic CDLC-8592 has four.
stages.note: Taken from the Jira automation rules, not from a sample. The chain is strictly sequential: Final Slides → PPT generation → Base Articulate file → Graphics → Articulate Review, which then creates Translations, Assessment, SME Review and External Review together. A Topic therefore carries different numbers of subtasks depending how far along it is. CDLC: Topic Corrections is not listed: it exists as a work type with 284 tickets, but no enabled rule creates it.

subtasks.name: Final Slides
subtasks.blurb: Created with the Topic itself.

subtasks.name: Graphic Definition
subtasks.blurb: Created with the Topic itself. Uses the generic Sub-task type — there is no work type for it.

subtasks.name: PPT generation
subtasks.blurb: Created when Final Slides is marked Done.

subtasks.name: Base Articulate file
subtasks.blurb: Created when PPT generation is marked Done, for Informational, Instructional, Interview and Practical courses only.

subtasks.name: Graphics
subtasks.blurb: Created when the Base Articulate file is marked Done.

subtasks.name: Articulate Review
subtasks.blurb: Created when Graphics is marked Done.

subtasks.name: Translations
subtasks.blurb: Created when Articulate Review is marked Done.

subtasks.name: Assessment
subtasks.blurb: Created when Articulate Review is marked Done.

subtasks.name: SME Review
subtasks.blurb: Created when Articulate Review is marked Done.

subtasks.name: External Review
subtasks.blurb: Created when Articulate Review is marked Done.

stages.name: Digitization Process
stages.blurb: Closes the course. One ticket holding every step that turns finished content into a live product on SkillCat.
stages.note: The container ticket is typed Digitization - Data Sheet Creation even though Data Sheet Creation is only one of the twelve steps inside it — the type name understates what the ticket holds. Five of the twelve subtasks borrow work types from outside the Digitization family.

subtasks.name: Request Badge and Course Image
subtasks.blurb: Commissions the course badge and cover image.

subtasks.name: Upload to AWS + Planning
subtasks.blurb: Moves the built course into AWS and plans its release.

subtasks.name: Review
subtasks.blurb: Checks the uploaded course before it is restored onto the platform.

subtasks.name: Restore on SkillCat
subtasks.blurb: Puts the course onto SkillCat itself.

subtasks.name: Create Data Sheet
subtasks.blurb: Produces the course data sheet.

subtasks.name: Course Metadata
subtasks.blurb: Fills in the descriptive data the platform lists the course by.

subtasks.name: Create Course Introduction
subtasks.blurb: Writes the course's introduction.

subtasks.name: QA – Generate Performance Report
subtasks.blurb: Generates the QA performance report for the finished course.

subtasks.name: Update Course Catalog
subtasks.blurb: Adds the course to the catalog so learners can find it.

subtasks.name: Run Image Archiving
subtasks.blurb: Runs the automation that archives the course's source images.

subtasks.name: Move Source Files
subtasks.blurb: Files the course's source material in its final location.

subtasks.name: Restrict Course Folder
subtasks.blurb: Locks down the course folder now that the course is published.
